note: One in-game rule and one practice drill per category. The rule forces the habit into ranked play, the drill builds the skill outside it; coaching practice is that the pair sticks where either alone does not. Sourced from published rank training plans and VOD-review guides (see docs/coaching-quality.md).

crosshair.rule: Pre-aim the next corner at head height before you reach it.
crosshair.drill: Practice Range, 5 minutes: pick a head-height reference line, strafe while keeping the crosshair on it, stop and take one shot. Then one deathmatch, headshots only, no crouch spraying.

movement.rule: Stop moving before the first shot, every time.
movement.drill: Practice Range, 5 minutes: stop, fire two to four bullets, reset. Then 4 minutes of strafe-stop-burst repetitions.

peeking.rule: After you shoot once, reposition. Never re-peek the same angle.
peeking.drill: Practice Range, 5 minutes: clear corners with a pre-aimed jiggle peek, returning to cover between each one.

positioning.rule: Only take space you can trade from or escape out of.
positioning.drill: Custom game, 5 minutes: take one layer of space, freeze, and check how many angles you have exposed before moving again.

utility.rule: Every ability serves one of four jobs: info, isolate, deny, escape. If it serves none, hold it.
utility.drill: Custom game, 5 minutes: cast each ability and say out loud which of the four jobs it served. Then 5 minutes of flash and smoke timing, counting down to the peek.

trading.rule: No solo first contact. On a pick, reset instead of chasing.
trading.drill: Custom game with a friend, 5 minutes: practise trade spacing, close enough to trade, far enough not to die to the same spray.

economy.rule: Buy with the team or save with the team. Never half-buy alone.
economy.drill: Two minutes before each round: check team credits and say the buy out loud before spending.

info.rule: Check the minimap after every kill and every death.
info.drill: Deathmatch or ranked, 5 minutes: build the habit of a minimap glance immediately after each kill and death.

timing.rule: Decide before the clock forces it: hit, split, or pivot.
timing.drill: Custom game, 5 minutes: set a decision timer and commit to a plan before it expires.

postplant.rule: For the first five seconds after the plant, no solo swings.
postplant.drill: Custom game, 5 minutes: rehearse post-plant positions on your usual map, one per site.

retake.rule: Retake on a countdown together, never one at a time.
retake.drill: Custom game, 5 minutes: practise the retake entry with utility first, then bodies.

mental.rule: Losing twice the same way means change the plan immediately.
mental.drill: After the session, two minutes: write down one mistake and the fix in your own words.

other.rule: Pick one focus for the week and hold it, rather than fixing everything at once.
other.drill: After each session, two minutes: document one mistake and one fix.
